articles.title: Cronos executes controversial blockchain rollback to recover crypto worth $111 million
articles.snippet: Validators rolled back nearly two hours of blockchain history to recover user assets. But the attackers still managed to get away with $9.19 million before Cronos halted the network.

articles.title: Joe Biden’s son to launch memecoin, will send to TRUMP holders: WSJ
articles.snippet: Hunter Biden will reportedly distribute 200 million of the LAPTOP token to his substack subscribers, members of a mailing list and investors in President Donald Trump’s memecoin.

articles.title: Coldcard third-wave attacker moves 45% of stolen Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Galaxy said 82% of Bitcoin stolen across all Coldcard attacks remains in the original addresses, with 18% moved in apparent laundering.

articles.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
articles.snippet: The rollback reversed legitimate activity alongside the attack, while $9.19 million remains unrecovered, according to Cronos.

articles.title: Coldcard Hacker Moves $7.7M, Nearly Half of Third-Wave Bitcoin Haul
articles.snippet: The attacker built 293 separate vaults for the stolen Bitcoin and is emptying them in order of size, largest first.
